title: Human methylarginine sites, v1.1.0 (PTM_Pipeline)
description: The human protein arginine methylation sites of DeAngelo, Silverstein & Shechter, Cell Chem Biol 33:1404-1421 (2026), with the code that builds them and the Methylarginine Site Explorer website. v1.1.0 uses the sources and methods of the paper, mapped to UniProt release 2026_03, with corrections to how some source records were placed on UniProt sequences: 13,365 sites on 4,723 proteins, and 6 pending sites. releases/v1.1.0/CHANGES.md says what changed since the published version (v1.0.0, also included).
